name: issue-618-downloads-picker
description: docs/specs/downloads.md: the fixture page downloads report.txt as it loads; the status bar says `↓ done` and Firefox's downloads panel stays shut (downloads-done.png); ctrl+b d opens the downloads picker over the page with the file under Recent, its state, size, host and end time (downloads-picker.png); Esc closes it, and the picker has cleared the segment's end state. The end time varies between runs, a few digits well inside the 0.5 % screenshot tolerance; the fixture server's port is fixed (28471).
